summary: Fix 23 pre-existing backend test failures caused by two related bugs: (1) the tests use VALID_TOKEN = 'valid.jwt.token' which is not a real JWT, so pyjwt.get_unverified_header() fails in the middleware and the request takes the JWKS path which returns 401; (2) the tests patch 'app.middleware.auth.jwt.decode' but the middleware uses 'import jwt as pyjwt' so the module-level name is pyjwt, not jwt — the patch silently does nothing and the real decode runs on the invalid token. The reference fix was applied to test_ingestion_api.py in the DATA_ACCURACY_FIXES sprint: generate a real HS256 JWT with jwt.encode({'email': TEST_EMAIL}, _JWT_SECRET, algorithm='HS256') and patch 'app.middleware.auth.pyjwt.decode' instead. Apply the same fix to test_cube_api.py (9 tests), test_engagements.py (3 tests), and test_review_api.py (11 tests). Also fix test_cube_api.py TestBySupplier mock rows to include abc_segment (now required by the get_by_supplier endpoint after DATA_ACCURACY_FIXES US-001). Additionally raise the SupplierPage supplier fetch limit from the server default of 50 to 500 so all suppliers appear in the table.

decisions.jwt_token_generation: Generate a real HS256 JWT at module level using jwt.encode({'email': TEST_EMAIL}, _JWT_SECRET, algorithm='HS256') with _JWT_SECRET = 'test-secret-key-32-chars-minimum'. The reference implementation is in backend/tests/test_ingestion_api.py lines 7-15.
decisions.patch_target: Patch 'app.middleware.auth.pyjwt.decode' not 'app.middleware.auth.jwt.decode'. The middleware does 'import jwt as pyjwt' (auth.py line 4), so the name in the module namespace is pyjwt. Python's unittest.mock.patch requires the name as it appears in the target module.
decisions.supplier_page_limit: Request limit=500 on the SupplierPage by-supplier API call. The endpoint cap is le=1000 so 500 is safe. Full server-side pagination is out of scope for this sprint.
decisions.abc_segment_in_mocks: Add 'abc_segment': None to _make_supplier_rows() in test_cube_api.py. The endpoint now does r['abc_segment'] which KeyErrors on plain dicts lacking the key. Adding it as None is correct for mock data where the pipeline hasn't run.

key_files: backend/tests/test_ingestion_api.py - REFERENCE: has the correct JWT pattern already applied. Lines 7-15: import jwt as _jwt, _JWT_SECRET = 'test-secret', VALID_TOKEN = _jwt.encode(...). Line 79: patches 'app.middleware.auth.pyjwt.decode'. This is the exact pattern to replicate.

backend/tests/test_cube_api.py - 9 failing tests. Line 12: VALID_TOKEN = 'valid.jwt.token'. Lines 77,128,165,206,252,283,336,372,411: all patch 'app.middleware.auth.jwt.decode'. Lines 228-239: _make_supplier_rows() missing abc_segment.

backend/tests/test_engagements.py - 3 failing CRUD tests. Line 12: VALID_TOKEN = 'valid.jwt.token'. Lines 41,85,112,134: patch 'app.middleware.auth.jwt.decode'. Lines 34-43: _make_client() uses wrong patch path and imports jose.JWTError (jose is not installed).
backend/tests/test_review_api.py - 11 failing tests. Line 13: VALID_TOKEN = 'valid.jwt.token'. Lines 90,120,148,178,205,253,288,334,380,413,437: all patch 'app.middleware.auth.jwt.decode'.
backend/app/middleware/auth.py - Line 4: 'import jwt as pyjwt'. Line 41: pyjwt.get_unverified_header(token). Lines 47,49,64: pyjwt.decode(). This is why the patch target must be pyjwt not jwt.
frontend/src/pages/dashboard/SupplierPage.tsx - Line 75: api.get('/cube/by-supplier') with no limit param, gets server default 50. Need to add params: { limit: 500 }.
patterns_to_follow: backend/tests/test_ingestion_api.py lines 7-15 and 77-80 — the exact JWT fix pattern. Copy verbatim: import jwt as _jwt; _JWT_SECRET = 'test-secret'; VALID_TOKEN = _jwt.encode({'email': TEST_EMAIL}, _JWT_SECRET, algorithm='HS256'); monkeypatch.setenv('SUPABASE_JWT_SECRET', _JWT_SECRET); patch('app.middleware.auth.pyjwt.decode', return_value={'email': TEST_EMAIL}).

userStories.title: Fix JWT mock pattern in test_cube_api.py and add abc_segment to supplier mock rows
userStories.description: backend/tests/test_cube_api.py has 9 failing tests. All fail because VALID_TOKEN = 'valid.jwt.token' is not a real JWT so middleware's pyjwt.get_unverified_header() raises an exception, token_alg becomes 'unreadable', the JWKS path is taken, SUPABASE_URL is not set, and a 401 is returned before any test logic runs. The patch target 'app.middleware.auth.jwt.decode' is also wrong — the middleware imports 'import jwt as pyjwt' so the name to patch is 'app.middleware.auth.pyjwt.decode'. Additionally, _make_supplier_rows() builds dicts without 'abc_segment', but the endpoint now accesses r['abc_segment'] (added in DATA_ACCURACY_FIXES sprint), which would KeyError after the JWT fix is applied. The reference fix pattern is in backend/tests/test_ingestion_api.py.

userStories.title: Fix SupplierPage loading only 50 suppliers by requesting limit=500
userStories.description: frontend/src/pages/dashboard/SupplierPage.tsx fetches all suppliers at line 75 with no limit param, so the server default of 50 applies. Engagements with more than 50 suppliers only show 50 in the table — the rest are silently missing with no indication to the user. The fix is to add { limit: 500 } to the API call params. The backend by-supplier endpoint accepts limit up to le=1000, so 500 is within bounds. Full server-side pagination with load-more is out of scope for this sprint.
acceptanceCriteria: Edit file: frontend/src/pages/dashboard/SupplierPage.tsx — on line 75, change 'api.get(`/api/engagements/${engagementId}/cube/by-supplier`)' to 'api.get(`/api/engagements/${engagementId}/cube/by-supplier`, { params: { limit: 500 } })' so the full list is fetched

Verify: the queryFn on line 74-76 in SupplierPage.tsx now includes { params: { limit: 500 } } in the axios call

risks: The _JWT_SECRET string must be at least 32 characters for HS256 (RFC 7518). Use 'test-secret-key-32-chars-minimum' or similar. The test_ingestion_api.py uses 'test-secret' which triggers an InsecureKeyLengthWarning but still works — match that for consistency.

test_engagements.py _make_client() is defined but may not be called by any test. Simplify it rather than trying to make it work with the fake_decode approach — the jose library is not in requirements.
After fixing JWT, test_cube_api.py TestBySupplier will fail with KeyError on abc_segment if US-001 doesn't also fix _make_supplier_rows(). US-001 covers both fixes in one story.
